painpoints.text: Edit-tool file writes landed with mtime 1970-01-01 (e.g. lib/components/fabro-validate/src/file_refs.rs in run 01M1Y2SMEVDHAFB59GZV9B84CQ), so cargo considered sources older than cached rlibs and silently skipped recompiles — a just-added pub fn was reported missing and behavior lagged edits until manual `touch`. Fix idea: the platform's file-write path should set a real mtime (or utime after write); agents should `touch` after edit_file when Rust builds seem implausibly stale.

observations: Raw-graph standalone linting cannot be a pure rules pass: two runtime transforms run before lint rules — @-file inlining (prompt/goal) and model_stylesheet MiniJinja rendering. The wrapper preprocesses both (file_refs.rs); any future pre-render pipeline transform needs a matching step there or the fast gate false-positives (found via code-review.fabro, whose templated stylesheet would otherwise fail).

nu gotchas hit: `graph(s)` in a double-quoted string interpolates `(s)` as a subexpression, and a command call inside a list literal (`[graph_from_toml $toml]`) becomes two bare list items — needs `[(graph_from_toml $toml)]`.
